rationale: Roberts is best positioned to write a narrow Reed v. Goertz-based reversal rejecting an “official-by-official compliance forecast,” while cabining Thomas’s advisory-opinion concerns by remanding merits/proper-defendant issues. Thomas is likely to dissent on originalist redressability/defendant-authority grounds, with a meaningful chance of one or two concurrences (especially Alito or Gorsuch) emphasizing Lujan limits while joining the Reed-controlled result.
